More listings, no inventory sitting around.   🎃 BONUS: VINTAGE → HOLIDAY DECOR  Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Easter…   Vintage ornaments and decorations are in HUGE demand right now. Etsy SEO has changed and if you’re still treating Etsy search as simply “put your keywords in the title”, you’re missing a lot. Etsy is increasingly using AI to understand what shoppers are searching for and what your listings actually contain. That means things like your attributes, tags, listing images and the information surrounding your product can all help Etsy understand where your listing belongs. In this video I go through 5 Etsy SEO and listing optimisation tips that I think a lot of sellers overlook including one involving your listing images and alt text that can also help Google understand your products. I also show you why you shouldn't just repeat the same keyword across all 13 tags, and how Etsy Marketplace Insights can give you actual search data to find new keyword opportunities. If you sell on Etsy and you're trying to get more views on your listings, these are the sorts of things I'd be looking at before blindly rewriting hundreds of titles. And that's basically what The Messy Seller is about: digging into the stuff behind Etsy search, testing what actually makes sense, and separating useful Etsy SEO from the advice that just gets repeated because someone said it once. If you're an Etsy seller, save this one especially if you've got a big catalogue of listings to optimise. #Etsy #EtsySeller #EtsySEO #EtsyTips #EtsySellertips
